i.norm: Verifies that {@link NodeIterator#remove()} deletes the current node (and its subtree) from the document while the iterator continues to traverse the remaining nodes correctly.
Walks the whole document with a fresh iterator and confirms it visits exactly the nodes described by {@code expectedTrace}.
Drains the iterator, asserting each emitted node is non-null and distinct from the one before it, then checks that the concatenated trace of visited nodes matches {@code expectedTrace}.

Appends a human-readable token for {@code node} to {@code trace}, followed by a ';' separator: elements are rendered as "tag" (plus "#id" when they carry an id), text nodes as their text, and any other node as its node name.
First pass: remove the element with id=1 (and its subtree) while iterating. The trace still records div#1 because it is visited before remove() is called on it.
A fresh traversal confirms div#1's subtree is gone from the document.
Second pass: remove the element with id=2 (and its subtree) while iterating.
A fresh traversal confirms div#2's subtree is gone too.
Iterates the whole document, calling {@link NodeIterator#remove()} on the node whose id equals {@code idToRemove}, and returns the trace of every node visited during the pass.
